title: Signal Delivery Status
description: Arrival of provider-initiated membership delivery to an agent destination. Separate from addressability (is_live) and match outcome (match_status). Experimental (signals.delivery_methods).

enumDescriptions.awaiting_read: Shipped; the destination has not read it yet. Normal and possibly days-long on some rails.
enumDescriptions.delivered: The destination has read the membership. Not an addressability claim.
enumDescriptions.failed: Delivery did not complete (no rail intersection, pin mismatch, rail error); delivery_error carries the reason.
